title: Seasonal variability and source diagnostics of ambient PAHs in Agra, India, using the CBPF and their health risk evaluation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,1243-1261
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00933B, Paper
Simran Bamola, Gunjan Goswami, Muskan Agarwal, Anita Lakhani
This study examines polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) associated with total suspended particulates (TSP) in an understudied residential area of Agra, India, within the highly polluted Indo-Gangetic Plain, highlighting urban-industrial exposure.
